BUYER QUESTIONS

Clear answers before the next step.

Can I enquire before choosing a model?

Yes. Describe the intended use, quantity and arrival date; add a reference or drawing if available.

What determines MOQ and lead time?

The model, materials, design versions, decoration, packaging and tooling affect the proposal. Small batches from 10 pieces and fast sampling apply to eligible projects; confirm the conditions in your quote.

What should my enquiry include?

A model or product idea, quantity, artwork, pack contents, destination and required arrival date are a useful start.

How many cups does a tasting for 100 guests need?

Start from one cup per guest per pour, then add a working margin for breakage and for guests who keep the cup. A three-pour flight for 100 guests is 300 cups plus your margin, not 100. Tell us the format and we size it with you.

Which sizes work for a flight of three pours?

Small formats - roughly 1.5 oz to 4.5 oz - are what tasting flights use, because the pour is a taste rather than a serve. If the same cup also carries a welcome drink, take the larger end of that range and confirm the pour volume with your beverage team.

Can the cups carry a logo and a tasting note?

Yes. A logo on one side and a tasting note, vintage or table number on the other is a common pairing. Both print in the same run; the artwork version and the exact print area are confirmed on the proof.

Can tasting cups be reused after the event?

Rigid plastic and silicone cups can be washed and reused, which is why venues standardise on them. Thin disposable formats are single-use. Tell us how many cycles the cup has to survive and we point you to the material that suits it.

采购常见问题

下一步之前，先说明白。

还没选定型号，可以询价吗？

可以。说明用途、数量和到货日期，有参考图或图纸可一并提供。

起订量与交期由什么决定？

型号、材料、图稿版本、装饰、包装与模具都会影响方案。按型号起订及快速打样适用于相应项目，条件需在报价中确认。

询价需要提供什么？

型号或产品想法、数量、图稿、包装组成、目的地及期望到货日期，是有效的起点。

100 人的品鉴活动要准备多少只杯子？

先按「每人每款一杯」算，再加上破损和客人带走杯子的余量。100 人、三款酒的组合是 300 只起步，不是 100 只。把形式告诉我们，我们和你一起算。

三款组合用多大容量合适？

品鉴组合通常用 1.5 oz 到 4.5 oz 的小杯型 —— 品鉴是尝一口，不是整杯服务。同一只杯子还要装迎宾饮品时，取这个区间的上限，并和饮品团队确认每杯份量。

杯子上能同时印 Logo 和品鉴说明吗？

可以。一面 Logo，另一面印品鉴说明、年份或桌号，是很常见的组合。两处同批印刷，图稿版本与印刷面积以打样确认为准。

品鉴杯活动后可以重复使用吗？

硬质塑料和硅胶杯可以清洗复用，这也是场地愿意统一用它们的原因；薄的一次性杯型只用于单场。告诉我们杯子要经历多少次使用，我们给对应的材质建议。

下一步

一起把项目需求明确下来。

提供型号或想法、数量、图稿、目的地及到货日期，可在询价中添加文件。
